summary: Create one Mercury Fiber canonical PortCo, retain Mercury Broadband and Mercury Wireless as aliases, and add Northleaf as the active controlling owner from the October 31, 2022 legal close. Treat fiber, fixed wireless and operating subsidiaries as one facilities-based rural broadband platform and exclude local assets, grants and financing vehicles.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Northleaf's exact economic percentage and fund allocation are not publicly disclosed.
Mercury Holdings' current minority percentage and the post-closing status of the other pre-close minority holders are not publicly disclosed.
recommendedActions: Create Mercury Fiber under canonical key mercury-broadband|united-states with Mercury Broadband and Mercury Wireless as aliases.
Add Northleaf Capital Partners as the active controlling owner beginning October 31, 2022 through NCP Mercury AIV LP and Mercury TopCo, LLC.
Preserve Mercury Holdings' pre-closing ownership and disclosed minority rollover without inventing a current percentage.
Do not create separate PortCos for Mercury's operating subsidiaries, local networks, fiber routes, fixed-wireless assets, grants, lenders or financing vehicles.
